name: Production Deployment, Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD, Observability, DR & SaaS Operations
technology_position: Cloud/provider neutral. Production provider, orchestration, observability and CI/CD product selections remain architecture decisions.
principles: Promote immutable tested artifacts rather than rebuild
Infrastructure and configuration are versioned and auditable
Production changes use controlled deployment paths
Observability and operational ownership are mandatory
Backup success is insufficient without restore validation
RTO/RPO must be demonstrated by exercises
Phase 28 security applies to all infrastructure and operational access
Production readiness remains gated by Phase 20/22 and this Phase 31 evidence
